message.content: In the conversation, Li Hua expresses interest in discussing the main character Kendall's motivation in the TV series Succession. He finds it intriguing how Kendall's struggles for power are tied back to his childhood experiences and how the constant rivalry and need for validation from his father Logan shapes him. Li Hua notes that the intensity of Kendall's journey keeps viewers engaged and rooted for him despite the harsh realities. He highlights the complexity of Kendall's motivations, suggesting that he is driven by proving himself both to his father and to the world. Li Hua also points out the toxic nature of Kendall's relationship with his father, noting that it seems to be an endless cycle of mutual disappointment and betrayal. Despite this, Li Hua acknowledges that there might be a chance for reconciliation, though it appears unlikely given the betrayals that continue to pile up. Li Hua speculates that Kendall's ultimate goal may be to break free from the family legacy rather than merely to take over. However, Li Hua remains uncertain whether Kendall will ever achieve a true sense of redemption, as the character seems to continually fall back into old patterns. Overall, Li Hua views Succession as a compelling drama that keeps viewers on the edge of their seats due to its intense character dynamics and unpredictable plot twists.
